raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly revised the criteria for counting members by deciding to count only individuals with blue-linked Wikipedia pages as "distinct members." This decision arbitrarily excluded verified members listed on the official band pages, such as Tad Bouve, Jon Olson, Ted Garland, Rick Griffen, Peter Whitehead, and Brian Karp for Letters to Cleo. This flawed methodology led to an inaccurate count of 6 members for Letters to Cleo instead of the correct total of 14 members, resulting in the wrong conclusion that Screaming Trees had more members.
